bot.name: OpprimoBot
bot.description: A classic Terran opponent that builds infantry backed by bunkers and siege tanks. Human difficulty is not yet calibrated.

formats.notes: Local Terran combat against ZZZKBot on Fighting Spirit 1.3 with x86 and x64 SC:R. See admission review for exact bridge and package versions.

mapConstraints: Legacy SC:R unit limits required by the experimental bridge.

learning.notes: Fixed fresh-history profile: strategy history, result statistics, profiler output and terrain cache/logs are disabled.

license.name: MIT
license.notes: Upstream README MIT declaration accepted for inclusion. The package preserves author attribution and requested research citation, dependency notices, exact patched source, and rebuilding material.

localDistribution.evidence: docs/opprimobot-admission.md: pinned source/dependency review, corresponding-source rebuild, and local x86/x64 combat validation.

publicCompetition.evidence: Track separately from local distribution; author outreach planned by Travis.

limitations: Terran only; other upstream races and teams/FFA have not been verified.
Requires ShieldBattery Terran BWAPI compatibility update bd63be767; partial BWAPI bridge and legacy unit limits.
Fighting Spirit 1.3 tested; irregular maps and late-game spell behavior need broader playtesting.

sourceReview.evidence: docs/opprimobot-admission.md and docs/opprimobot-bwta-review.md; exact patched source and dependency headers rebuild from the package.
